item.description: PHILADELPHIA (AP) — Left-hander Jesús Luzardo and the Philadelphia Phillies have agreed on a $135 million, five-year contract that starts in 2027, a person familiar with the deal told The Associated Press on Monday. item.title: Leonard powers the Clippers past the Knicks to reach .500 for the first time since November
